request_user:
Fact: data_acquisition
What to find: How training data was obtained and selected, including annotation and synthetic-data generation methods and how rights were obtained.
Card sections that often contain it: Training Data, Data Collection

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: The card says pretraining used a staged curriculum of web, code, math and reasoning data, with a public data mixture; pretraining datasets are in a public collection, while mid-training and post-training datasets will be uploaded later. Mid-training used 140B reasoning tokens. The card gives no details on annotation, synthetic-data generation or how rights were obtained, and points to an EU public summary of training content.
quotes: it was pretrained on 11.2T tokens with a staged curriculum of web, code, math and reasoning data. Post-training included midtraining on 140B reasoning tokens followed by supervised fine-tuning and alignment via Anchored Preference Optimization (APO).
**Fully open model**: open weights + full training details including public data mixture and training configs

The datasets used for pretraining can be found in this [collection](https://huggingface.co/collections/HuggingFaceTB/smollm3-pretraining-datasets-685a7353fdc01aecde51b1d9) and those used in mid-training and post-training will be uploaded later

The EU AI Act requires all GPAI models to provide a Public Summary of Training Content according to a [given template](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/library/explanatory-notice-and-template-public-summary-training-content-general-purpose-ai-models).
